title: thelypteris pyrrhorhachis
intro: Thelypteris pyrrhorhachis, commonly known as the cinnamon fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris pyrrhorhachis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic and antitumor activities.
